name: Zendesk Ticket Assistant
summary: Classifies incoming Zendesk support tickets, drafts replies for simple issues, and flags VIP customer escalations.

items.title: Incoming Zendesk tickets
items.description: Reads incoming support tickets from Zendesk to process them.
items.proved_when: Tickets are successfully fetched from Zendesk.

items.title: Ticket urgency and team classifier
items.description: Analyzes the ticket content to determine urgency and assign the right team.
items.proved_when: Each ticket receives an urgency level and team tag.
items.source_quote: Classify incoming Zendesk tickets by urgency and team

items.title: Simple reply drafter
items.description: Creates a draft response for straightforward customer support requests.
items.proved_when: A draft reply is generated and attached to simple tickets.
items.source_quote: draft a reply for simple ones

items.title: VIP customer escalation
items.description: Identifies VIP customers and immediately flags their tickets for urgent handling.
items.proved_when: VIP tickets are marked as escalated in the system.

not_in_this_version.title: Automated ticket closing
not_in_this_version.reason: Human review is required for all drafted replies before sending to ensure quality.
